text.p: These are significant stories in the Nigerian press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Central bank announces removal of board of directors from troubled Commerce Bank and names a three-man transitional supervisory board in its place.

- National Electoral Commission bars politicians from its headquarters, after party leaders beseiged the building anxious to know whether they would be allowed to take part in the transition to civilian rule.
- Merger of drug companies Sterling Products and Smithkline Beecham imminent. The matter will be considered by shareholders on Thursday.

- Nigerian National Petroleum Corporation to adopt new contract arrangements for carrying refined petroleum products to depots. From December 1 payments will be based on the volume carried rather than on the length of time that a vessel is used.
- Customs service begins crackdown on "undesirable elements" at Seme border post with neighbouring Benin.
